text:
packet-02 - unverified image-only reading

Exposure: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this item. Proper names below (in a rubric and in the text) are transcribed because they are written on the leaf; I have not used them to look anything up or to supply text.
Beyond the rules: image-001 is photographed sideways, so I made a rotated copy (90 degrees clockwise) of image-001 and 2x upscaled quadrant crops of that copy, in my own scratchpad, and read from those. No other file was opened. All line numbers below are counted in that rotated orientation (text upright), from the first text line at the top of each column, not from the top edge of the raw image-001.

LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
- image-001 is a reduced overview of an opened parchment bifolium reused as a limp binding/wrapper: spine strip in the middle with later paper labels and a later ink inscription (numbers, "1655"?), a later paper label with a capital K pasted on the right face, a small paper label "1/" at the top of the spine, fold creases, stains, holes.
- Each face has two columns of a single text, dark brown ink, a compact gothic book hand (late protogothic/early gothic look; no date inferred). About 31-32 lines per column visible; lower edge may be trimmed.
- Left face, column a, lines 4-5: a red rubric ending one item and beginning another, followed by a red/orange penwork-decorated initial (letter not clear; boxed) and a line in capitals "[F?]UIT QVIDAM". Thin blue/red paragraph marks appear at the far left edge, on a turned-in strip.
- Inner margins carry later cursive marginal notes in a lighter ink (short glosses or catchword-like jottings, mostly illegible at this resolution); one note in the upper margin of the right face ("in quo scribant(?) ..."), and one in the outer margin of right face column d ("deficere"?, repeating a text word).
- image-002 is the only native-resolution tile, and it covers only the spine strip: pasted paper slips with faint printed or written text (illegible: "...in...", "...til ab..." ?) plus later ink marks ("1", a number like "565" or "1655"?). It contains none of the main text.
- Text order: the left face (cols a, b) appears to come first: col a opens the item with the rubric and capitals; the right face continues the same narrative. Whether the faces are consecutive (inner bifolium) is not certain.

SELECTED SPANS
I read all four columns at overview resolution as far as I could; everything is uncertain at this resolution. Readings that I could not make out are [illegible]; many line starts at the gutter and the turned-in edge are lost.

UNREAD / LIMITATIONS
- Everything above comes from a reduced overview (about 1800 x 1291 px for the whole bifolium); no native-resolution tile of the text was supplied. Abbreviation marks are mostly guessed from shape at this resolution. Treat each word as provisional.
- Unread: the gutter-side starts of col a lines (turned-in edge) and of col c lines (fold), the darkened areas of col b lines 17-19 and col c lines 3-6, the later marginal/interlinear cursive notes, and the spine slips (image-002, text faint and illegible).
- The last line of each column may be cut at the lower edge.
- Recommended: native-resolution tiles of all four columns, especially column a (rubric and opening, lines 1-10) and column d lines 1-13 (around the K label), plus a raking or enhanced view of col c near the fold.
